---
title: "Run Plan demo"
format: html
---

This notebook exists to try the Run Plan button. Each chunk prints a counter and its own label, so the order in which the chunks ran can be read from the console. Nothing is written to disk.

The chunks are deliberately out of order: `save-checkpoint` sits above the chunks whose result it stores.

```{r setup}
demo_step <- 0
tick <- function(label) {
  demo_step <<- demo_step + 1
  cat(sprintf("[%d] %s\n", demo_step, label))
}
tick("setup")
```

```{r save-checkpoint, eval = FALSE}
tick("save-checkpoint")
checkpoint <- list(data = d, total = total)
cat("checkpoint holds", nrow(checkpoint$data), "rows and total", checkpoint$total, "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: summarise
tick("summarise")
total <- sum(d$value)
cat("total is", total, "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
tick("load-data")
d <- data.frame(id = 1:3, value = c(10, 20, 30))
```

```{r}
#| label: fail-on-purpose
#| eval: false
tick("fail-on-purpose")
stop("this chunk stops on purpose")
```
